introHtml: Soft shell nursing scrubs combine the professional look of traditional uniforms with the stretch and comfort of athletic wear. The soft shell fabric moves with you during long shifts, resists wrinkles, and holds up to frequent washing. For bulk buyers, this means a polished appearance that lasts. Decorate with embroidery or heat transfer logos on the chest or sleeve for a clean, durable finish that won't peel or fade.
